title: Bella Vita A103 Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Enjoy the good life with gorgeous Gulf views and incredible amenities at Bella Vita in Blue Mountain Beach. This sophisticatedly decorated condo has been designed to meet every guest's need - no compromises to make with a stay at Bella Vita A103.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH WITH NO RESTRICTIONS. - Stunning Ocean Views - Gorgeous furnishings - Gated Community - Short walk to the beach (within steps), community pool, shopping, and dining - Fully stocked kitchen - Access to community amenities including dual Gulf-facing pools (heated seasonally), gym, outdoor grills, outdoor dining area, poolside lounge seating, and private beach entrance. State of the Art community gym with Hoist Fitness System plus free weights, treadmills, ellipticals, and stationary bikes. - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) Enjoy the good life with gorgeous Gulf views and incredible amenities at Bella Vita in Blue Mountain Beach. This sophisticatedly decorated condo has been designed to meet every guest's need; no compromises to make with a stay at Bella Vita A103. With 2,200 square feet and 3-bedroom suites to sleep 6 guests, there is plenty of room for everyone. The master suite has balcony access, Gulf views and a luxurious bathroom. In the main hallway you'll find the laundry room plus a convenient powder room for guests. For the little ones in your group, this unit comes with a Pack 'n Play and highchair. Bella Vita boasts a spacious, fully equipped kitchen, complete with high-quality appliances and breakfast bar. Choose between eating at the breakfast bar, the dining table with seating for 8, or at a table on your patio looking at the Gulf and pristinely maintained grounds. Located in the quiet and charming beach community of Blue Mountain, Bella Vita is a gated community sitting on the highest elevation point along the Gulf coast. This beautiful 3-bedroom condo features an open-concept living space which includes gourmet kitchen, dining room, wet bar and a large living room. And we can't forget to mention the private balcony with stunning Gulf views. Lush, resort-style landscaping will take your breath away, as will the views from the balcony of the 2 sparkling pools (seasonally heated)! And don’t forget the short walk to your private beach access. ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 6) Bedroom 1: King, bed, TV, balcony access. Private bathroom with dual sinks, jetted tub and walk-in shower. Bedroom 2: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo. Bedroom 3: Queen bed, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo. ADDITIONAL DETAILS: * Sandpiper cannot guarantee/service owner-provided amenities * Fireplace is not for guest use. * Sorry, no pets allowed. * This complex does not allow golf carts or bikes * Parking for 2 cars on a first come, first serve basis. * Elevator and stair access to condo. Luggage carts available at the parking deck level. SPECIAL NOTE during hurricane season: Should the owner of the unit choose to evacuate New Orleans, LA due to the approach of a hurricane or tropical storm in said area the following will apply: If you have a pending reservation, it is subject to cancellation with a full refund of your payment. If you are already in the unit, you will be given 24 hours notice to exit the rental. In this event, any unused portion of your stay will be refunded. FREE WIFI

Health And Safety: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF

all: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
